name: Clean URL
description: Strip well-known tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_*, ig_*, msclkid, etc.) from a URL. Conservative blocklist — bare `ref` and `source` are NOT stripped because they're commonly used by legitimate APIs (e.g. GitHub raw URLs). Compound forms like `ref_src` / `ref_url` ARE stripped. Returns { input, cleaned, removed }.
